cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(zen_tests LANGUAGES CXX)

# --- Embedding test ---
add_executable(test_embedding test_embedding.cpp)
set_target_properties(test_embedding PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${ZEN_BIN_DIR})

# Multi-config generators (Visual Studio) append the config name to the output
# directory — pin each config so the binary always lands in ZEN_BIN_DIR.
foreach(cfg DEBUG RELEASE RELWITHDEBINFO MINSIZEREL)
    set_target_properties(test_embedding PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_${cfg} ${ZEN_BIN_DIR})
endforeach()
target_link_libraries(test_embedding zen_static)

# --- Load-time script introspection ---
add_executable(test_script_info test_script_info.cpp)
set_target_properties(test_script_info PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${ZEN_BIN_DIR})
foreach(cfg DEBUG RELEASE RELWITHDEBINFO MINSIZEREL)
    set_target_properties(test_script_info PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_${cfg} ${ZEN_BIN_DIR})
endforeach()
target_link_libraries(test_script_info zen_static)

# --- GC-safe natives ---
add_executable(test_gc_native test_gc_native.cpp)
set_target_properties(test_gc_native PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${ZEN_BIN_DIR})
foreach(cfg DEBUG RELEASE RELWITHDEBINFO MINSIZEREL)
    set_target_properties(test_gc_native PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_${cfg} ${ZEN_BIN_DIR})
endforeach()
target_link_libraries(test_gc_native zen_static)

# --- C++ binding layer (zen_bind.hpp) ---
add_executable(test_bind test_bind.cpp)
set_target_properties(test_bind PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${ZEN_BIN_DIR})
foreach(cfg DEBUG RELEASE RELWITHDEBINFO MINSIZEREL)
    set_target_properties(test_bind PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_${cfg} ${ZEN_BIN_DIR})
endforeach()
target_link_libraries(test_bind zen_static)

# --- Godot-style node engine mock bound with zen_bind.hpp ---
add_executable(test_node_engine test_node_engine.cpp)
set_target_properties(test_node_engine PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${ZEN_BIN_DIR})
foreach(cfg DEBUG RELEASE RELWITHDEBINFO MINSIZEREL)
    set_target_properties(test_node_engine PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_${cfg} ${ZEN_BIN_DIR})
endforeach()
target_link_libraries(test_node_engine zen_static)

if(EMSCRIPTEN)
    foreach(t test_embedding test_script_info test_gc_native test_bind test_node_engine)
        set_target_properties(${t} PROPERTIES SUFFIX ".js")
        target_link_options(${t} PRIVATE
            -sNODERAWFS=1
            -sALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1
            -sEXIT_RUNTIME=1
            -sSTACK_SIZE=8388608)
    endforeach()
endif()

# --- Host output hook (only meaningful with the option on) ---
if(ZEN_HOST_OUTPUT)
    add_executable(test_host_output test_host_output.cpp)
    set_target_properties(test_host_output PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${ZEN_BIN_DIR})
    foreach(cfg DEBUG RELEASE RELWITHDEBINFO MINSIZEREL)
        set_target_properties(test_host_output PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_${cfg} ${ZEN_BIN_DIR})
    endforeach()
    target_link_libraries(test_host_output zen_static)
endif()
